A.reason: Host diagnostics show HTTP 200 for /api/v1/system/session/ensure and the first /api/v1/game/start, but do not prove the complete Android preflight; the later failure coincided with game-provider restart/unavailability and remains an S06 boundary.

B.reason: A neutral hidden warm-up that lost transport was RECONNECT_REQUIRED, but the requested game could not match the neutral snapshot and fell through to replacement confirmation. The existing saved-session resume and pending-game relay now own that exact correlated path.

contracts: A PLAYNITE_GAME request over an exact neutral RECONNECT_REQUIRED warm-up resumes the saved neutral stream without confirmReplacement, destructive close or a fresh Sunshine launch.

SessionStateResolver preserves that exact neutral RECONNECT_REQUIRED state when Sunshine still reports the same neutral app active and the bridge reports idle; another live app, a confirmed game, and a live retained owner keep their existing precedence.
ConsoleActivity permits that handoff only for the exact pending host, profile, neutral target, warm-up attempt, retained app and stream-session identity.
The resumed Game receives the existing pending-game relay and all three provider capability flags before the retained coordinator re-enters PREPARING.
Cancellation or a superseding generation makes a delayed opaque-frame callback inert.
S08 remains the owner of unrelated warm-up concurrency refinements. S06 remains the owner of provider restart stability and coherent host observation.
